card.name: Acute before a disease in patient lists
card.fires_on: The word "acute" (or its ending "ute"), and sometimes "with", right where a patient condition is about to be named, mostly after "contraindicated in patients with".

modes.label: Acute before an organ condition
modes.description: "acute" or "Ac-ute" introducing a condition such as liver failure or renal insufficiency in contraindication lists.
modes.example: is contraindicated in patients with<< acute>> liver failure or decompensated cir

modes.label: With before a named illness
modes.description: "with" linking patients to a disease name.
modes.example: An imaging study of people<< with>> primary-progressive MS at Massachusetts General Hospital

card.writes: It pushes toward words for illness and disease, such as ill, sick, chronic and diabetes.
card.plain: It lights up on "acute" or "patients with" when a disease name is about to follow.
